facts.text: Serve the snacks when Charles tries his lines on a girl in the Oxford pub.
facts.why: The Wikipedia plot has Charles earning his doctorate at Oxford but does not mention a pub scene, and the Wikiquote page has none. I could not confirm it from an opened source.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Xavier and Erik meet at Division X.

facts.text: Served between moves of Charles and Erik's chess.
facts.why: The plot and quote page I opened have no chess game, so I could not confirm it.
facts.fix: Served between Charles and Erik's rows over mutant rights.

facts.text: Erik's pour. Charles already knows he wants one.
facts.why: The sources I opened do not show Erik pouring Scotch. Erik does order a drink at the German bar in Argentina.
facts.fix: Erik's pour, from the German bar in Argentina.
